channel.title: DREAM Lab blog (UIUC)
channel.description: Plain-language explainers of research from the DREAM Lab at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

item.title: Agent Primitives: Reusable Latent Building Blocks for Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: Agent Primitives (ICML 2026): reusable latent building blocks for LLM multi-agent systems, composed by an Organizer and connected via KV-cache communication.

item.title: The Hidden Cost of Prompt Injection Defense
item.description: Prompt injection defenses are scored on attack success, which hides lost content. SecFid (ICML 2026 Spotlight) measures both security and fidelity.

item.title: How to Test Whether Your Product Descriptions Influence AI Shopping Recommendations
item.description: A step-by-step protocol for testing whether product descriptions change AI shopping recommendations, using the CORE method and ProductBench.

item.title: CORE: Controlling Output Rankings in Generative Engines for LLM-based Search
item.description: Project page for CORE: controlling output rankings in generative engines for LLM-based search, with the ProductBench benchmark and results on four LLMs.

item.title: CORE Explained: How to Improve Visibility in LLM-Based Search (Step by Step)
item.description: A step-by-step explainer of CORE, our method for studying how retrieved content changes rankings in LLM-based search, with definitions and FAQ.

item.title: SEO vs GEO vs CORE: Techniques for Visibility in LLM-Based Search
item.description: A comparison of SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), and our CORE method for how content is ranked in LLM-based search, written by the CORE authors.

item.title: When More Reasoning is Actually Less: The Science Behind Optimal Thinking in LLMs
item.description: Why more chain-of-thought can hurt LLM accuracy: the inverted U-curve, three failure modes of reasoning, and the case for adaptive reasoning.

item.title: From Parameter Learning to Prompt Learning: The Evolution of Prompt Optimization
item.description: How prompt optimization mirrors the history of neural network training, from perturbation methods to gradient-based techniques, and what may come next.

item.title: 1000 Ideas for Your Next Trustworthy Machine Learning Paper
item.description: Three universal frameworks for generating trustworthy ML research ideas across robustness, adversarial security, interpretability, and fairness.
